alerts.description:
* WHAT...North winds 10 to 20 kt with gusts up to 25 kt expected
and waves 4 to 7 ft expected.

* WHERE...Nearshore Waters from Sheboygan to North Point
Lighthouse.

* WHEN...From 1 AM Tuesday to 1 AM CDT Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
